column1: # Swedish (sv). Drafted 2026-11-05 and decided through the three-vendor debate (l10n/decisions/sv/); ships as beta. See l10n/README.md for each field.
# percent_style and decimal_style use a no-break space (U+00A0) between the number and the sign and as the thousands separator, never U+202F, which Saira lacks.
